svg.title: claudia — what a person can do to an object, in all three apps
svg.desc: Three panels (creates, computes, composes) each showing a selected picture with eight handles and a turn handle and the same object context menu; below, a composes table with its name tab, one frame, a width handle, a drop line and the table menu; and the stacking rule with its one Ctrl+click exception.
svg.text: claudia — one way to take hold of an object, in all three apps

Mock-up for review (menus as in claudia-menus-4). Left press selects; drag moves its anchor; handles scale; the top handle turns; right press selects and opens the object menu — nothing passes through to the page, the cells or the text below.
the reference: behaves like this today
a text box or shape also has
Edit text (Enter); a chart no Rotate
adapts: the anchor is a cell
dashed: the cell it is anchored to
cells stay below: a right press
adapts: the anchor is a paragraph and a character
press, drag, scale, turn as in creates
A table in composes — one body, one frame
in the flow; selected by its name tab or frame; a click in a cell is for typing
drop line while the table is dragged: it will land after the paragraph above
faint frame and cell lines are an editing aid: they are not printed and the look still decides what the page shows
no turn handle, no bottom handle: the table's height is the layout's
Before: a second, empty violet box lay over the table and caught the click on Options….
Now the object layer does not draw tables at all; TableView is the only body.
Keys: Esc in a cell leaves the table for the text · Tab / Select Next Object reach it
Delete removes it; arrows move it between paragraphs; Enter opens Table options…
its own commands, as Edit has none (menus-4)
on the tab, on the frame or inside a cell:
the same menu; the table is selected
no paragraph menu, no browser menu
text and cells are always at the bottom
Normal: the object is over the words
a click selects it; to reach the words under it, move it
the words are above it, so a plain click is for the caret;
hold Ctrl and the object is taken (grab cursor).
Ctrl + click or Tab / Edit ▸ Select Next Object
• left press: select · drag: move · release: anchor set
• handles: scale · top handle: turn · Esc mid-gesture: undo it
• right press: select + object menu, nothing below it
• every step is one history entry, for everybody
